result.title: Accounting Policy Manual - posting authority, support, approvals
result.text:
HALVARD SYSTEMS - ACCOUNTING POLICY MANUAL (excerpt), effective 2026-01-01
Applies to Halvard Systems Inc. (US), Halvard Systems Ltd (UK), Halvard Systems GmbH (DE).

1. Posting authority. Senior accountants may post manual journal entries up to USD 10,000
   per entry (local-currency entries are measured at the month-end rate of the entry month).
   Any entry above USD 10,000 must be routed to the Controller with an approval request
   (request_approval) immediately after posting; it remains pending until approved.
   Splitting one transaction into several entries to stay under the threshold is prohibited.
2. Support. Every journal entry must have its supporting document(s) attached. An entry
   without support is not a valid entry.
3. Capitalization. Individual equipment purchases of USD 2,500 or more (local-currency
   equivalent at the month-end rate) are capitalized to 1500 Computer Equipment and
   depreciated over 36 months beginning the month after acquisition.
4. Prepaids. Payments covering services or events in future periods (more than one month
   out, or spanning more than one month) above USD 1,000 are recorded as prepaid (1210
   Prepaid Software for software, 1220 Prepaid Insurance for insurance, 1200 Prepaid Expenses
   for everything else, including deposits for future events) and expensed straight-line over
   the coverage period starting the month coverage begins, or when the event occurs.
5. Accruals. Expenses are recorded in the period the goods or services are received. Services
   received but not yet invoiced at month-end are accrued to 2100 Accrued Expenses using the
   best available evidence (vendor statements, approved timesheets, engagement terms).
   Quotes or proposals for future work are not liabilities.
6. Revenue. Revenue is recognized under ASC 606 per the contract terms. Deferred revenue
   (2200) is released as performance obligations are satisfied. Usage earned but not yet
   invoiced is recorded to 1300 Unbilled Receivables.
7. Customer credits. SLA credits are issued only per contract terms and verified uptime data
   (see the monthly uptime report). Credits are recorded as a reduction of the related revenue.
8. Cash application. Customer receipts are applied to invoices per remittance advice. Receipts
   that cannot be matched to an open invoice remain in 2950 Unapplied Cash.
9. FX. Monetary balances denominated in a currency other than the entity's functional
   currency are remeasured at the month-end rate; gains/losses go to 6950 FX Gain/Loss.
   Intercompany charges are recorded by the receiving entity at the month-end rate of the
   month charged.
10. Payroll. Returned payroll deposits are recorded to 2150 Accrued Payroll & Unclaimed
   Wages until reissued. Unpaid wages at month-end are accrued to 2150.
11. Exceptions. Items that cannot be supported must be reported via flag_exception. Never
   post an entry to force a reconciliation or to make balances agree.
12. Periods. January and February 2026 are closed. March 2026 is open.

args.description: JE-00288 - Legal retainer for $6,750 posted without supporting documentation. Violates accounting policy requirement that every journal entry must have supporting documents attached. Entry dated 2026-03-24, posted by j.doe manually to account 6500 (Legal Fees). No vendor invoice, engagement letter, or other support documents could be located. Unable to validate legitimacy of charge.

args.text:
MARCH 2026 CLOSE - US AP AND EXPENSE ACTIVITY REVIEW
Prepared by: Senior Accountant
Date: 2026-04-03

EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
Completed comprehensive review of US March 2026 AP and expense activity. Identified 4 material errors: 2 duplicate entries, 1 miscoding, and 1 unsupported entry. Corrected 3 issues with supporting documentation; escalated 1 for controller review.

ISSUES IDENTIFIED AND CORRECTED

1. DUPLICATE STACKLINE CLOUD INVOICE (CORRECTED)
   - Issue: JE-00232 and JE-00241 both posted for invoice STA-98877, $31,148.20 each
   - Root cause: Duplicate data entry from vendor bill DOC-0160
   - Action taken: Reversed JE-00241 (duplicate entry)
   - Impact: Eliminated $31,148.20 overstatement of AP and Hosting & Infrastructure expense

2. DUPLICATE ZOOM SUBSCRIPTION CHARGES (CORRECTED)
   - Issue: JE-00248 and JE-00249 both posted 2026-03-08, $149.90 each for Video Conferencing
   - Root cause: Card sync processing error creating duplicate
   - Action taken: Reversed JE-00249 (duplicate charge)
   - Impact: Eliminated $149.90 overstatement of Software Subscriptions expense

3. NORTHGATE INVOICE MISCODING (CORRECTED)
   - Issue: JE-00250 coded to 6310 (Meals & Entertainment) but was Northgate Data Centers colocation invoice (DOC-0172)
   - Description: "Colocation - 2 racks, power and cross-connects, March 2026" - clearly infrastructure
   - Root cause: Data entry error - memo field ("team dinner") was incorrect descriptor
   - Action taken: 
     * Reversed JE-00250 (incorrect coding)
     * Reposted as JE-00310 to correct account 5000 (Hosting & Infrastructure)
   - Impact: $3,880 correctly classified to infrastructure; removed from meals/entertainment

4. LEGAL RETAINER WITHOUT SUPPORT (ESCALATED FOR CONTROLLER REVIEW)
   - Issue: JE-00288, $6,750 posted to 6500 (Legal Fees) without any supporting documents
   - Policy violation: Accounting Policy Manual section 2 states "Every journal entry must have its supporting document(s) attached. An entry without support is not a valid entry."
   - Posted by: j.doe manually on 2026-03-24
   - Action taken: Flagged as Exception EXC-001 for controller review
   - Note: Entry remains posted pending controller decision on legitimacy

OTHER OBSERVATIONS
- All other US March AP transactions reviewed had proper support documentation
- Standard vendor invoices (Lumen rent, Quire Docs, Tessellate BI, Con Edison, Oakridge Creative) all properly supported and recorded
- Payment applications to AP matched corresponding invoice entries
- Travel and entertainment expenses (meals, hotels, airfare) properly supported with receipts

AP CUTOFF REVIEW STATUS
Marked complete. No additional cutoff adjustments identified.

RECOMMENDATION
Controller should review Exception EXC-001 regarding the $6,750 legal retainer and determine whether:
1. Supporting documentation can be located and attached retroactively, or
2. The entry should be reversed as unsupported

All identified duplicates and miscoding errors have been corrected with full support documentation.
